02 Workbench log

Still a student.
Already shipping.

I’m studying Electronics & Communication Engineering with a specialization in VLSI at VIT Chennai. I founded and captain the Chip Designers Guild, where we design RTL, write verification suites, prototype on FPGAs, and tape out on open-source ASIC PDKs.

I’m also an R&D intern at Sentrix Robotics developing tactile and environmental sensing platforms for Physical AI, and building semiconductor workflow tooling at TapeItOut. My portfolio is a lab workbench, not marketing copy: architecture, verified metrics, and ongoing regressions are labeled clearly.
